title: Graham Hancock's first article on the Ark of the Covenant

tellings.quote: interviewed Graham Hancock and his the first piece that he ever did was it was like for a I think a magazine or something and he was writing an article on the ark of the covenant.

plain: The writer Graham Hancock's very first piece of work was an article about the Ark of the Covenant, written for what Michels thinks was a magazine. Michels repeats this from his own interview with Hancock and is unsure of the details, so the story rests on his memory of what Hancock told him.
